body:
Founder real-time follow-up to the mixforge.okemily.com launch: queued songs in the multiplayer room broadcast a log line but never play. Real finding: media/stream.prn's own resolved design (PARENA/STDLIB.md sec28) is for one native process fanning ONE outbound stream to MULTIPLE external destinations (Twitch/YouTube-style relay) -- a different-shaped problem than getting several already-connected browser tabs to play the same already-downloaded file in sync. Same reframe this repo's own 4-deck mixer update already proved live: Web Audio + PARENA-WASM DSP shipped real crossfade without ever needing media/audio.prn either. Scoped a real, buildable architecture in NORTHSTAR.md instead: server-side download-on-queue reusing the already-shipped 'mixforge import' CLI (shell out, don't reimplement), nginx static-serves the cached file, clients round-trip clock-sync and use Web Audio's sample-accurate start(when) to play in sync -- zero new PARENA stdlib domain required. Named the real, honest simplifications (download latency before playback starts, no mid-song late-join seek yet, per-client download instead of a relay fan-out, and licensing stakes going up again with a real server-side cached copy). Resolves open kanban triage items T48839675/T94858758. Also fixed a real repo/live nginx config drift found along the way (certbot's SSL additions weren't folded back into the checked-in vhost file). No playback code shipped yet -- this is the scoping pass only, per explicit user direction (asked to scope rather than quick-patch). MIXFORGE@b260e4c.

⚓ ☃
title: MIXFORGE Phase 5 scoped -- room playback doesn't need media/stream.prn
